```{r}
players <- data.table::fread("../data/raw/Hudl IQ 2021 player roster.csv")
raw_events <- data.table::fread("../data/raw/Hudl IQ data for Wharton School/Hudl IQ 2021 NFL Events.csv")
freeze <- data.table::fread("../data/raw/Hudl IQ data for Wharton School/Hudl IQ 2021 NFL Events + Freeze Frame.csv")
hudl_game_id <- data.table::fread("../data/raw/hudl_iq_game_ids.csv")
```
```{r}
special_events <- freeze %>%
  filter(!is.na(end_engagement_uuid)) %>%
  pull(end_engagement_uuid) %>%
  unique()

special_events_1 <- freeze %>%
  filter(!is.na(start_engagement_uuid)) %>%
  pull(start_engagement_uuid) %>%
  unique()
```

```{r}
raw_events <- raw_events %>%
  filter(event_uuid %in% c(special_events,special_events_1))

freeze_uuid <- freeze %>%
  pull(event_uuid) %>%
  unique()

raw_events <- raw_events %>%
  filter(!(event_uuid %in% freeze_uuid))
```

```{r}
freeze <- bind_rows(
  freeze,
  raw_events
)
```

```{r}
library(nflreadr)
games_info <- load_schedules(seasons = 2021) 

library(nflfastR)
games_info_legacy <- fast_scraper_schedules(2021)

games_subset <- games_info_legacy %>%
  select(game_id, season, week, game_type,
         away_team, away_score,
         home_team, home_score,
         gameday)
```

```{r}
hudl_game_id_mod <- hudl_game_id %>%
  mutate(nflfast_game_id = ifelse(game_id==1502157,"2021_09_GB_KC", nflfast_game_id),
         nflfast_game_id = ifelse(game_id==1502141,"2021_09_LAC_PHI",nflfast_game_id),
         nflfast_game_id = ifelse(game_id==1502228,"2021_09_LV_NYG",nflfast_game_id),
         nflfast_game_id = ifelse(game_id==1502219,"2021_17_LA_BAL",nflfast_game_id),
         game_id = ifelse(nflfast_game_id=="2021_11_MIA_NYJ",1502168,game_id),
         game_id = ifelse(nflfast_game_id=="2021_10_BAL_MIA",1502144,game_id),
         game_id = ifelse(nflfast_game_id=="2021_13_NYG_MIA",1502189,game_id)
         )

games_data_1 <- hudl_game_id_mod %>%
  left_join(games_subset,by = c("nflfast_game_id" = "game_id"))

games_data_1 <- games_data_1[complete.cases(games_data_1),]

# clean up memory - remove dataframes no longer referenced
rm(hudl_game_id_mod, games_subset, games_info_legacy, games_info)
gc()
```


```{r}
sub_data <- freeze %>% 
  group_by(play_uuid) %>% 
  filter(
    any(event_types %in% c("{Pass}","{\"\"Jump Catch\"\",Catch}","{Pass,\"\"Defender Touched\"\"}","{Catch,\"\"Defender Touch\"\"}","{Break-Up,\"\"Defender Touch\"\"}","{\"\"From Pass\"\",\"\"Ball To Ground\"\"}","{Catch}","{\"\"Over Shoulder Catch\"\",Catch}","{Batted-Ball,\"\"Defender Touch\"\"}", "{Sack,Tackle}","{Pass,Hit}","{Passer-Hit}","{\"\"Jump Catch\"\",Catch,\"\"Defender Touch\"\"}","{Pass,\"\"Defender Touched\"\",Hit}","{Intercepted,Pass,\"\"Defender Touched\"\",Hit}", "{Interception,Catch,\"\"Defender Touch\"\"}","{\"\"Ball To Ground\"\",\"\"From Pass\"\"}","{Tackle,Sack}","{Pass,Intercepted,\"\"Defender Touched\"\"}","{Catch,\"\"Defender Touch\"\",Interception}","{Pass,Hit,\"\"Defender Touched\"\"}","{Intercepted,Pass,\"\"Defender Touched\"\"}","{Interception,\"\"Jump Catch\"\",Catch,\"\"Defender Touch\"\"}","{\"\"Over Shoulder Catch\"\",\"\"Jump Catch\"\",Catch}","{\"\"Defender Touch\"\",Batted-Ball}","{Hit,Pass}","{Catch,\"\"Defender Touch\"\",\"\"Over Shoulder Catch\"\"}","{Pass,\"\"Defender Touched\"\",Intercepted}","{Hit,Pass,\"\"Defender Touched\"\",Intercepted}","{Hit,Pass,\"\"Defender Touched\"\"}","{\"\"Defender Touched\"\",Pass}", "{Intercepted,\"\"Defender Touched\"\",Pass}","{\"\"Defender Touch\"\",Interception,Catch,\"\"Jump Catch\"\"}","{\"\"Defender Touch\"\",Catch,\"\"Jump Catch\"\"}","{\"\"Defender Touch\"\",Catch}"
                           ))) %>% 
  ungroup()

sub_data <- sub_data %>%
  group_by(play_uuid) %>%
  filter(!any(event_types %in% c("{Handoff}","{Lateral}"))) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
players_pos <- players %>% 
  filter(!is.na(player_id)) %>%
  distinct(player_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  select(player_id, team_position_name, team_name)

```

```{r}
sub_data_pos <- sub_data %>% 
  left_join(players_pos, by = "player_id") %>%
    rename(event_player_position = team_position_name,
         event_player_team = team_name.y)

```

```{r}
sub_data_pos <- sub_data_pos %>%
  select(-team_name.x)
head(sub_data_pos,100)

# clean up memory - remove dataframes no longer referenced
rm(sub_data)
gc()
```

```{r}
sub_data_pos <- sub_data_pos  %>%
  left_join(players_pos, by = c(opponent_player_id = "player_id")) %>% 
  rename(opponent_position = team_position_name,
         opponent_team = team_name)
```


```{r}
sub_data_pos %>%
  filter(event_uuid=="dec8956c-be39-4e98-8540-2785c04cd05f")

```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

sub_data_pos <- sub_data_pos %>% 
  group_by(game_id) %>%                                
  mutate(
    freeze_frame_player_id = if_else(
      is.na(freeze_frame_player),
      NA_integer_,
      coalesce(
        player_id          [ match(str_trim(freeze_frame_player),
                                   str_trim(event_player_name   )) ],
        opponent_player_id [ match(str_trim(freeze_frame_player),
                                   str_trim(opponent_player_name)) ]
      )
    ),
    freeze_frame_position = if_else(
      is.na(freeze_frame_player),
      NA_character_,
      coalesce(
        event_player_position [ match(str_trim(freeze_frame_player),
                                      str_trim(event_player_name   )) ],
        opponent_position     [ match(str_trim(freeze_frame_player),
                                      str_trim(opponent_player_name)) ]
      )
    ),
    freeze_frame_player_team = if_else(
      is.na(freeze_frame_player),
      NA_character_,
      coalesce(
        event_player_team [ match(str_trim(freeze_frame_player),
                                  str_trim(event_player_name   )) ],
        opponent_team     [ match(str_trim(freeze_frame_player),
                                  str_trim(opponent_player_name)) ]
      )
    )
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r}
sub_data_complete <- sub_data_pos %>%
  left_join(games_data_1,by = "game_id")

# clean up memory - remove dataframes no longer referenced
rm(sub_data_pos, games_data_1)
gc()
```


```{r}
trimmed_hudl_pass_data <- sub_data_complete %>%
  select(-c(game_quarter,event_yards_after_catch,event_catch_fail_type,event_kick_fail_type,event_kick_distance,event_kick_lateral,event_pass_air_yards,event_pass_catchable,event_pass_overthrow,event_pass_underthrow,event_pass_placement_x,event_pass_placement_y,event_pass_yards_gained,event_pass_placement_uncollectable,event_pass_comp_prob,event_catch_comp_with_placement,event_catch_comp_without_placement,partition_0, receiver_player_name,receiver_player_id,receiver_alignment_position_id))

# clean up memory - remove dataframes no longer referenced
rm(sub_data_complete)
gc()

cat("\nMemory usage after final cleaning:\n")
cat("trimmed_hudl_pass_data:", format(object.size(trimmed_hudl_pass_data), units = "MB"), "\n")
```

```{r}
# save the cleaned dataset
data.table::fwrite(trimmed_hudl_pass_data, "../data/processed/full_hudl_data.csv")

# print summary of the saved dataset
cat("Dataset saved to ../data/processed/full_hudl_data.csv\n")
cat("Number of rows:", nrow(trimmed_hudl_pass_data), "\n")
cat("Number of columns:", ncol(trimmed_hudl_pass_data), "\n")
cat("File size:", format(object.size(trimmed_hudl_pass_data), units = "MB"), "\n")
```

# Extra Max Stuff

```{r}
pass_time <- sub_data_complete %>%
  filter( play_uuid=="a0dc69e6-c5f9-4a81-a823-e92a3efc918c" & event_types == "{Pass}") %>%
  pull(time_since_snap) %>%
  unique()

sample_play<-sub_data_complete %>%
  filter(play_uuid=="a0dc69e6-c5f9-4a81-a823-e92a3efc918c" & event_types %in% c("{\"\"Engagement Start\"\"}","{\"\"Engagement End\"\"}"))
sample_play
sample_play %>%
  group_by(opponent_player_name, event_player_name) %>%
  summarise(
    start_time = time_since_snap[event_types == "{\"\"Engagement Start\"\"}"][1],
    end_time   = time_since_snap[event_types == "{\"\"Engagement End\"\"}"][1],
    total_time = end_time - start_time,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pass_time
```

```{r}
clean_check<-sub_data_complete %>%
  filter(event_types %in% c("{\"\"Engagement Start\"\"}","{\"\"Engagement End\"\"}")) %>%
  select(play_uuid,opponent_player_name,event_player_name,time_since_snap,event_types) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(play_uuid,opponent_player_name, event_player_name) %>%
  summarise(
    start_time = time_since_snap[event_types == "{\"\"Engagement Start\"\"}"][1],
    end_time   = time_since_snap[event_types == "{\"\"Engagement End\"\"}"][1],
    total_time = end_time - start_time,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
nrow(clean_check[is.na(clean_check$start_time),]) / nrow(clean_check)
nrow(clean_check[is.na(clean_check$end_time),]) / nrow(clean_check)
nrow(clean_check[is.na(clean_check$total_time),]) / nrow(clean_check)
clean_check
```
